name: Confluent Cloud
description: Confluent Cloud integration for Datadog. Ingests Kafka cluster metrics via the Confluent Cloud Metrics API.
note: Configure in Datadog Integrations > Confluent Cloud tile or via API. The Datadog Confluent Cloud integration natively supports metric ingestion from the CC Metrics API. See https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/confluent_cloud/ for setup instructions.
